text:
ops-bot: ALERT: notify-service failed to deliver pages to PagerDuty for ~7m. delivery_error=queue_write_timeout event_id=evt-9f3a5 link=https://internal/alerts/evt-9f3a5
alex: seeing this — oncall getting pages?
oncall-jordan: I didn't receive any pages. I was at my desk. no phone ring.
maya: same, nothing here. was alerted only after someone pinged directly in #incidents.
sam: digging — notify-relay returned repeated 502s to /v1/pager/send and the outbound queue consumer stalled. log snippet:
```
2026-03-17T14:22:01Z notify-relay error: write timeout to sqs (seq=124578)
2026-03-17T14:22:04Z consumer stall: last-ack=124560 current-head=124578
```
alex: can we trigger the manual fallback (direct webhook fanout) and get oncall paged now?
maya: triggering manual page to PagerDuty now (INC-10023). also calling oncall phone.
deploy-bot: action: manual-webhook-fanout triggered by maya — routing bypass=queue
oncall-jordan: I just got the page, thanks. :white_check_mark:
sam: confirmed: outbound requests now succeed, ack lag dropping. consumer code was hitting a header-parsing exception after a malformed external webhook, causing the consumer to crash and leave the queue unprocessed.
alex: quick mitigation: restart the notify-relay consumer and enable strict header validation in front of it. maya, can you roll a 2-node canary with validation turned on?
maya: on it. running: `kubectl -n notify set env deploy/relay HEADER_STRICT=true --record` and `kubectl rollout restart deploy/relay -n notify --selector=canary=true`
deploy-bot: canary rollout started for deploy/relay (2 pods).
sam: canary pods healthy, no more header exceptions in logs. outbound throughput normalizing.
alex: good. root cause hypothesis: malformed third-party callback introduced unexpected header shape; consumer deserialization raised exception which prevented commit of queue offset (consumer stalled).
oncall-jordan: customer impact? did any paying customers miss pages?
maya: initial count: ~13 pages for 3 customers delayed by ~5–8 minutes. no persisted incidents in customer side, but visible delays.
sam: created INC-10023, assigned to alex for postmortem and follow-up.
alex: I'll own the postmortem. action items: (1) add header schema validation + metric + alert on consumer lag > 30s; (2) improve consumer error handling to skip bad message and advance offset; (3) add a PagerDuty escalation test in CI.
maya: i'll update status page draft in 10m and ping support to notify affected customers.
oncall-jordan: standing by for any reoccurrence. thanks for the quick manual page.
alex: timeline will go into INC-10023. tagging @sre-duty for follow-up automation requests.
ops-bot: NOTE: the incident was auto-escalated to P1 for 8m while paging was suppressed.
maya: will schedule retro and update runbook to include manual-fallback steps.
alex: thanks — will post a short summary and link to INC-10023 in ~30m.
